LESSON: WRITING 9.3.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING – POSTERS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can posters be used to foster cohesion among people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of a poster for information

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 9.3.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING – POSTERS
This lesson teaches Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters for Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify features of a poster for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters above.
2. Explain Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 9.3.1 Functional Writing – Posters important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can posters be used to foster cohesion among people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify features of a poster for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
